title: epitrachys leucocephala
intro: Epitrachys leucocephala, commonly known as the White Horse Nettle, is a plant species native to tropical regions, specifically in the Philippines. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as treating fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Epitrachys leucocephala include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its ability to alleviate respiratory issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
